summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q2 and half-year 2026 financial results. The filing contains standard earnings metrics: net sales of EUR 4,815 million (+8% y-o-y), comparable operating margin of 9.0% (+70 bps), and EPS of EUR 0.00. Key strategic commentary notes reclassification of two discontinued operations and strong AI Cloud demand. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, etc.) is announced. Routine financial disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
